verdict.rationale: Brex documents first-party autonomous background agents. An audit agent continuously monitors expenses and a review agent auto-approves low-risk items, escalates exceptions and follows up. These run alongside user-configured spend rules that Brex AI applies to every transaction, auto-enforced limits, and automatic multi-level approval routing. Community skepticism calling the AI features gimmicky is general and not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring agents and custom triggers (the evidence is marketing-level), general-purpose user-defined automations beyond spend workflows without third-party tools, and independent hands-on corroboration.
